run_scenario: run the agent on a given scenario with a notification system and optional initial agent logs
stop_agent: stop the running simulation agent by calling the stop method on the agent instance
create_subclass: create a subclass of RunnableARESimulationAgent that implements the run_scenario abstract method
raise_agent_stopped_exception: raise the AgentStoppedException to signal that the agent has been stopped during execution
review_runnable_agent_interface: review the RunnableARESimulationAgent abstract base class and its run_scenario and stop method signatures
